configurePresets.name: onemill-base-win-msvc-x64
configurePresets.description: Build policy shared by every OneMill configuration. Intentionally hidden: OneMill cannot configure without machine-specific paths (QTDIR, Qt6_DIR, VCPKG_ROOT, VTK_DIR, MODULEWORKS_DIR), so the selectable presets live in CMakeUserPresets.json. Copy CMakeUserPresets.json.example to CMakeUserPresets.json and adjust the paths - otherwise your IDE's preset list will be empty. VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET must be set here as a cache variable: CMakeLists.txt sets it only AFTER including the vcpkg toolchain, so by then vcpkg has already resolved the default dynamic x64-windows prefix and find_package(cpr) and friends fail. cmake-gui users do not hit this because the triplet is already in their cache. There is deliberately NO Debug configuration: it builds and installs but cannot run - static CRT gives MainApp and each of the ten plugin DLLs its own heap, and the debug heap asserts on the first allocation that crosses a module boundary. Debug the RelWithDebInfo build instead. See open item 5 in .vscode/OneMill-Setup-Ledger.md for what reviving Debug would require.

buildPresets.name: onemill-build-base
buildPresets.description: Builds the default target 'all' on purpose. MainApp does not depend on the ten plugin DLLs under bin/<config>/modulesBert (it links only ModuleInterface and ModuleUtils), and the per-module add_custom_target(... ALL) copy targets for config/, releaseNotes/ and the ModuleWorks deps/ folders are unreachable from it, so pinning a target list would silently produce an app with no modules and no config data.

buildPresets.name: onemill-install-target-base
buildPresets.description: Runs only the 'install_full' custom target and assumes the app is already built - use the matching Install workflow preset for the full job. install_full stages MainApp, Updater, every enabled module and the Qt/VTK runtime into INSTALL_DIR, passing windeployqt the flavour that matches the configuration (--release for both RelWithDebInfo and Release; there is no Debug configuration). The sibling targets 'install_plugins' (modules only) and 'install_fitting' (standalone KLSOneAnalyse deployment into INSTALL_DIR_FITTING) are not wired to presets; run them with cmake --build <dir> --target <name>. Note that the install script passes --no-compiler-runtime, so the staged folder still needs the VC redistributable present on the target machine.
